leads.name: Choupo-negro de Requeixadas
leads.why: ICNF register (processo KNJ1/216): girth 6.2m, height 20m, crown 15m, age_register 104 as measured in 2006 (so roughly 124 by 2026). Independently, a 2009 compilation blog (venerablesarboles.blogspot.com, 'Arvores Monumentais de Coimbra, Portugal') lists a Choupo/Populus nigra at Sao Martinho do Bispo with circumference 5m, height 22m, age 90, which is a plausible earlier-vintage snapshot of the same tree (growth trajectory is consistent) rather than a fresh independent measurement, so treat the two-source bar as thin here. NOT SHIPPED THIS PASS on access: the register's 'lugar' is 'Quinta das Requeixadas', and a search found only 'Casa do Bispo / Quinta de Sao Martinho do Bispo', which is the historic estate now occupied by the ESAC campus, in the same freguesia. Whether 'Quinta das Requeixadas' is public ESAC ground, a separate private quinta, or something else could not be confirmed this pass. Resolve that before verifying further; do not assume it is open. [2026-09-25 verify pass, exposure-4 brief: confirmed via ICNF register (processo KNJ1/216, girth 6.2m, height 20m, crown 15m, age_register 104 measured 2006, so roughly 124 by 2026) and independently found a 2009 compilation blog (venerablesarboles.blogspot.com) with a closely matching entry for 'Requeixadas, São Martinho do Bispo': circumference 5m, height 22m, age 90, Populus nigra L. Two figures close enough to be the same tree at an earlier measurement, so treat as corroboration rather than a fresh independent count. ACCESS STILL UNRESOLVED: Nominatim reverse-geocodes the coordinate to 'Campos de Sao Martinho' farmland in the Bencanta area, near EN 111-1, not conclusively the ESAC campus. Tried to settle access via Overpass (the Ypres technique) and could not: overpass-api.de and its lz4 mirror both returned HTTP 406, overpass.kumi.systems timed out (curl -m 20, exit 28). No tourism, path or public-access source found by web search either. Still a lead: needs either a working Overpass query, a local source naming the field as open farmland/a public path, or written confirmation that Requeixadas sits on ESAC's open grounds, before it can ship.

leads.name: Cedro-do-atlas (ICNF, 8.4km out)
leads.why: ICNF register (processo KNJ1/201): girth 3.7m, height 31m, crown 14.5m, age_register 108 as measured 2015, so roughly 119 by 2026, at Quinta da Zombaria, Alcarraques, Trouxemil e Torre de Vilela (Coimbra concelho). SECOND SOURCE FOUND: venerablesarboles.blogspot.com's 2009 Coimbra compilation lists the same tree at the same quinta, matching the girth (3.7m) and height (31m) exactly, but giving its age as '1000 anos'. That figure fails the physical sanity check the register-pitfalls rule calls for: Cedrus atlantica is a North African species with no cultivation history in Portugal before the 19th century, so a planted specimen cannot be a thousand years old. Recorded here as a conflict, not resolved in either direction: the register's 108-years-as-of-2015 figure is the only plausible one and should be preferred if this tree is ever written up, but do not silently drop the blog figure without noting the discrepancy. ACCESS UNRESOLVED: Quinta da Zombaria reads as a private rural estate (postal-code and place-name sources only; no tourism, visiting or public path information found). Nearest mapped road is the EN 111 primary road, which does not by itself establish that the tree stands on public ground. Tried Overpass to check access tags on the estate boundary directly (the Ypres technique): overpass-api.de and its lz4 mirror both 406'd, overpass.kumi.systems timed out. Needs a working Overpass query or a local source confirming public access before this can ship; per hard rule 10, when in doubt leave it out.

leads.name: Sobreiro (ICNF, 10.3km out)
leads.why: ICNF register (processo KNJ1/169): girth 4.6m, height 15m, crown 27.7m, age_register 308 as measured 2007, so roughly 327 by 2026, at Quinta do Rol, Anca, Cantanhede concelho (note: this is OUTSIDE Coimbra municipality, about 10.4km from Coimbra centre; if it ever ships it may belong on its own Anca/Cantanhede page rather than folded into Coimbra, per the rule that the container should never be assumed to be a city). One of the oldest-dated candidates in the whole Coimbra-area set. SECOND SOURCE FOUND: venerablesarboles.blogspot.com's 2009 compilation lists 'Coimbra, Cantanhede, Anca, Quinta do Rol, Sobreiro, P4,2m h16m 300anos Quercus suber', close enough on girth (4.2m vs 4.6m), height (16m vs 15m) and age (300 vs 308) at a different measurement date to corroborate the same tree rather than conflict with it. The same blog also lists a second, separate cork oak at 'Quinta da Sobreira' nearby (P4.8m h17m 300anos), not to be confused with this one; that may be the same tree as the other 'Sobreiro (ICNF, 12.1km out)' lead already in this file, unconfirmed. ACCESS UNRESOLVED: Quinta do Rol appears to be a working wine estate (portugalvineyards.com lists it as a wine brand; that page 403'd on fetch so could not check for public wine-tourism visits). No public path or visiting information found. Tried Overpass to check access tags: same 406/timeout failures as above. Needs a working Overpass query, a call to the estate, or a local tourism source before it can ship; per hard rule 10, when in doubt leave it out.

leads.name: Glicinia n.1 (ICNF, 13.6km out)
leads.why: Register only: girth 2.3m, age_register 97. Not researched this pass. [2026-10-29 verify pass] Terreiro de Penacova (ICNF KNJ1/314; n.2 is KNJ1/315, register girth 0.1 m is likely a data error). Junta de Freguesia de Penacova (jfpenacova.pt/patrimonio-cultural-edificado, fetched) describes the Raul Lino pergola at the main terreiro, between the town hall and the neoclassical court building, as a belvedere 'coberta por velhas cepas de glicinias'; open public terrace over the Mondego. Second figure: venerablesarboles 2009 blog gives n.1 girth 1.95 m, 89 years (vs register 2.3 m, 97). Alive: iNaturalist observation 2026-06-05 at the coordinate (lifecheck RECENT). Register coordinate 40.2701,-8.2807 lands on the Posto de Turismo de Penacova (Nominatim), beside the terreiro: approximate. HELD ONLY ON DISTANCE: Penacova is outside Coimbra concelho, about 14 km by road (23 min by car) but public transport is 45 to 60 min with a few departures a day (search listings: rome2rio, moovit, not fetched), beyond the 30-minute day-trip bound. Ready to verify as its own Penacova tree page (pergola as one collectible ensemble, small named site radius 30 m) if the day-trip bound is waived. n.1 and n.2 fold into one entry.

leads.name: Quinta das Lagrimas camphor tree and sequoia
leads.species: Camphor Tree (Cinnamomum camphora) / Coast Redwood (Sequoia sempervirens)
leads.why: Hotel gardens, open to day visitors for a small fee (Time Out listing 2.50 EUR, Tue-Sun 10:00-18:00, prices disagree across sources, not fetched). Dias com Arvores 2005 comment: a camphor tree 'merece os 3 euros da visita'; the same report names olaias (Judas trees) and a sequoia 'que se diz ter sido plantado pelo Duque de Wellington' (florestas.pt repeats two sequoias planted in 1813): that date is implausible for Sequoia sempervirens, which reached Europe in the 1840s, so do not use it. No measurements, no coordinates; the garden is a walk-through park, not a small site. Owner (quintadaslagrimas.pt/pt/servicos/jardins/1077, fetched) says only 'arvores raras e de grande porte'. Needs a register or survey with measurements and a pin. The fig (cbr_005) is already published.
